description.purpose: Lexical retrieval over the builder's knowledge base: the spec and the template catalogue, plus -- where the tree carries them -- the cookbook patterns, the corpus briefs and the pinned error codes, chunked by section and ranked with BM25.
description.use_when: In front of any authoring cell, so a model retrieves the pattern instead of carrying the whole corpus in its prompt. One per builder hive.
description.not_in_scope: No embeddings and no semantic leg: a local chat endpoint serves no embedding model, and metered embeddings for a corpus that answers to names would be the wrong trade. No writes at runtime -- the seed is a build product of this repository's corpus generator, and a published tree carries a corpus built from the published sources alone (#441).
examples: 'a timer that writes a note every hour' -> BM25 over docs -> the timer cell section, the scheduled-workflow cookbook pattern
retrieve -> store(search) -> retrieve(brief) -> the authoring cell's prompt
